article.adventurer_note.title: Adventurer's Note
article.adventurer_note.content1: The ancient wanderer returns to the world
article.adventurer_note.content2: The homeland no longer exists, and the familiar but strange world is waiting for him
article.adventurer_note.chapter1.title: Prelogue · The Unconscious from Far Lands
article.adventurer_note.chapter1.body1: His familiar stars have no longer existed, which was replaced by endless darkness and quiet
article.adventurer_note.chapter1.body2: He could remember that tons of civilizations born under the stars, but faded in the long nights finally
article.adventurer_note.chapter1.body3: At last he woke up among the darkness, but the whole world never runs in his familiar way
article.adventurer_note.chapter1.body4: He picked out the strange thing in his pocket, only to find a shabby note
article.adventurer_note.chapter1.body5: The ancient boom era is coming to and end, and us who lived happily would eventually pass away
article.adventurer_note.chapter1.body6: In this strange world, you will have no companion and be all alone. But I can't explain the reason in detail to you. §lBriefly speaking, you will fulfill our dream of wandering for a thousand years.§r
article.adventurer_note.chapter1.body7: Survivors of "Alteration", our homeland has perished yet. Countless hardships have reduced even the hardest rocks to dust. You should have grown under the stars, but instead you were forced to waste your time in the cage.
article.adventurer_note.chapter1.body8: But at this very moment, the vast world is open for you to explore. The past and the future, history will be written by you.
article.adventurer_note.chapter1.body9: May you find your own answers after the slumber in a foreign land.

item.hiddenyears:copper_badge.story: "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from saving me, so far from the words of my groaning?"
item.hiddenyears:golden_badge.story: "O my God, I cry out by day, but you do not answer, by night, and am not silent."
item.hiddenyears:diamond_badge.story1: "I will use the bones of the dragon to lay the foundation of the holy seat for your return."
item.hiddenyears:mask_of_the_sea.story0: According to the legend, when the GOD unleashed their divine punishment, the sea also boiled over - and then the deep waters near the center of the earth nearly froze
item.hiddenyears:mask_of_the_sea.story1: But the GOD bestowed upon the followers the power of the ocean, enabling them to seek refuge from disasters in the deepest parts of the sea
item.hiddenyears:sparkling_mask.story0: "Child, you have no idea that at the end of the celestial realm of this world, there are no truly starry skies or moonlit nights."
item.hiddenyears:sparkling_mask.story1: "Throughout my entire life, I have been entangled in this false sky."
item.hiddenyears:soldiers_helmet.story0: According to legend, before Hell became Hell, humans and the immortal race lived there
item.hiddenyears:soldiers_helmet.story1: But the king of mankind suddenly passed away, and the subjects prayed to the heavens, hoping to receive divine assistance
item.hiddenyears:soldiers_helmet.story2: -- But all they received was a "divine prophecy" from above:
item.hiddenyears:soldiers_helmet.story3: "Proditor... the immortal race... was completely wiped out."
item.hiddenyears:soldiers_helmet.story4: So thousands of soldiers put on such helmets and charged towards their former comrades
item.hiddenyears:herders_hat.story: The ordinary shepherd's cap. According to the legend, when worn, it will bring the protection of the guardian angel of agriculture and animal husbandry
item.hiddenyears:farmers_hat.story: The ordinary farmer's straw hat is said to bestow the protection of the Angel of Agriculture and Husbandry upon the wearer when worn
item.hiddenyears:invisible_cape.story: In the original realm, such "perfect invisibility" existed only in the virtual world and was impossible to achieve in reality
item.hiddenyears:invisible_cape.story1: What exactly made this cloak achieve such perfect invisibility? No one knows
item.hiddenyears:thorns_cape.story: The cloak bestowed by the sorcerer from the forest has received the protection and blessing of the "Vanaspatti", the angel of the trees
item.hiddenyears:fire_cape.story0: After being stained with the crimson red and the light of death in hell
item.hiddenyears:fire_cape.story1: In accordance with the instructions of the GOD: "Throw away those useless burdens, and then I will lead you to rebuild Eden in the new world."
item.hiddenyears:fire_cape.story2: So the injured person was left there, enduring the scorching heat for thousands of years
item.hiddenyears:miners_glove.story: The miner's gloves might bestow blessings during the digging process
item.hiddenyears:fighters_glove.story: The gloves worn by the mutated and deranged warriors in the Lunar Eclipse Chronicles
item.hiddenyears:engulf_glove.story0: "Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth,"
item.hiddenyears:engulf_glove.story1: "And I heard a loud voice from the throne saying, 'Now the dwelling of God is with men, and he will live with them. They will be his people, and God himself will be with them and be their God.'"
item.hiddenyears:engulf_glove.story2: "Kossislo said, Look, all the new arrivals will submit to me - he then told me that they would build a temple together with Proditor, and offer various pure animals and birds as burnt offerings on the altar."
item.hiddenyears:engulf_glove.story3: "Therefore, God granted him the divine throne and allowed him to rule over the newly born human beings; and Proditor became the deity of immortal."
item.hiddenyears:ruby_ring.story: Originally, it was a cheap ring, but after being worn by the King of Ruby, over time it also absorbed some of his powers
item.hiddenyears:cursed_ring.story0: The sky collapsed and the earth crumbled. Dark forces from the world erupted and merged into a monstrous dragon. Then, the GOD turned this world into three sections. The topmost section was used to subdue this dragon
item.hiddenyears:cursed_ring.story1: However, this also led to the remaining old humans falling into the deepest abyss and becoming monsters, weeping forever - and after that terrifying war in the ancient times, tears would become the last drop of water in their bodies
item.hiddenyears:speed_boots.story: Just a boot which can give you speed effect
item.hiddenyears:hare_boots.story: Just a boot which can give you jump boost effect
task.title: Task
task.body: The traveler travels across the four seas, seeking the truth of the world
task.prologue: §d Prologue §r The Stranger in the Old Land
task.prolugue.act_1: §d Prologue · Act I §r The Long First Day
task.prolugue.act_1.desc_1: The travelers who once roamed the ancient starry sky have returned to the world
task.prolugue.act_1.desc_2: Hometown has already cracked, but this familiar yet strange world awaits him
task.stick.desc: These are the new branches sprouting from the tree, and they are also the beginning of your journey
task.crafting_table.desc: The core of the game and the story
task.furnace.desc: Use eight cobblestones to make a furnace
task.bed: Why does life fall into slumber
task.bed.desc: Because we will eventually wake up from the dream
task.bread.desc: Bake bread with wheat on the crafting table
task.monster_hunter.desc: The world is not as safe as you might think. At night, there are monsters that try to kill you
task.prolugue.act_2: §d Prologue · Act II §r Sharpen Your Equipment
task.prolugue.act_2.desc_1: The traveler, gazing at a perilous world, set out on the path of sharpening his equipments
task.bone_tools.desc: In ancient times, people used bones for divination, while nowadays people turn it into tools and weapons
task.bone_tools.tips: You can use bone to make weapons, tools and armors
task.stone_craft.desc: Mine stones with your new pickaxe -- it's said that in a certain other world, you can even compress cobblestone into something far more powerful
task.copper.desc: A common metal found across the world, craft it into tools and armor – yet it rusts with time
task.copper.tips: Copper tools and weapons won't be rusted because of Mojang
task.refined_rock.desc: Smelt the stone embryos of stone, netherrack or end stone to obtain this refined material--though no one really knows the science behind it
task.refined_rock.tips: Craft stone embryos by arranging Any Stones in an X shape at Crafting Table, then smelt the corresponding embryos to obtain Refined Rock Ingots.
task.iron.desc: Forged in the starry depths, this substance is now the most common material across the continent
task.saw.desc: This tool mines logs at an exceptional speed and yields you extra loot
task.saw.tips: Craft a saw with sticks, string and ingots on the crafting table
task.crowbar.desc: A thief's go-to tool, often used to pry loose metal blocks
task.crowbar.tips: Craft a crowbar on the crafting table with two metal ingots and one corresponding metal nugget
task.hammer.desc: The hammer crafted from ingots and a metal block is exceptionally heavy, yet perfect for miners
task.hammer.tips: The hammer grants an extra mining speed boost and has correspondingly higher durability when mining
task.dagger.desc: A sharper weapon, yet far more fragile
task.dagger.tips: Craft a dagger with one ingot and a stick
task.sledgehammer.desc: Barely different from a miner's maul, but lightened for brutal combat swings
task.sniper_duel.desc: A crude ranged weapon made of sticks and string, yet surprisingly effective at times?
task.trigger_blade.desc: Claim the pillager's weapon -- the crossbow
task.sharpening.desc: Reinforce bows and arrows at the fletcher's table to craft Enhanced Bows and Enhanced Arrows
task.shield.desc: Craft a shield with wooden planks and an iron ingot
task.skewer.desc: Craft a spear with a stick and an ingot
task.prolugue.act_3.desc_1: The traveler roams the four seas, seeking rarer materials and uncovering the world's mysteries--
task.prolugue.act_3.desc_2: Yet this is merely a beginning
task.silver.desc: The rarest and sturdiest material before diamond, obtained by mining Mystic Silver Ore underground
task.diamond.desc: Countless years ago, humans once believed this to be the mightiest material in the world...
task.crystal.desc: Obtain Enchanted Amethyst Shards with a low chance by mining Amethyst Clusters or Amethyst Ore, then smelt the shards to get Arcane Crystal Ingots
task.god.desc: Trade with Librarians to learn of the world's deities
task.bleak_totem.desc: A totem dropped by Illagers, seemingly a symbol of some lost and powerless authority...
task.totem.desc_1: Countless millennia ago, a star beyond the horizon suddenly blazed, and then a stranger from the heavens descended upon this land.
task.totem.desc_2: Darkness shrouded heaven and earth, and when light returned, the Undying Clan--bearers of the Totem of Undying and the blessing of Immortality, the ultimate pursuit of ancient humans throughout history--was born.
task.totem.desc_3: Yet all beings that refused to submit were left to weep for eternity in the Nether...
task.infested_beast.desc: A monster mutated during the Lunar Eclipse, far fiercer for bearing the world's memories
task.infested_beast.tips: Seek the Ancient Trial Grounds underground and click the Trial Stone to summon the trial monster
task.contract_stone.desc: A crystal that bears a Pact, usable with the Trial Stone.
task.contract_stone.tips: Use the Stone of Pact on an activated Trial Stone to obtain trinkets
task.memory_condensation.desc: The azure moon fades to corruption, and beneath it, humanity succumbs to madness.
task.memory_condensation.desc_2: In their final hour, they chose to entrust their memories to these trinkets, awaiting rebirth in the future.
task.chapter_2.act_2.desc: The traveler embarks on a new journey, stepping into an uncharted world...
task.gold.desc: Once the most common thing in the Nether before it became a purgatory, now a precious metal to barter with Piglins
task.obsidian: §d[Nether Exploration]§r Fusion of Fire and Water
task.obsidian.desc: Mix water and lava, and might a strange substance be born?
task.ghast_tear.desc: A substance forged from the endless wrath and resentment of unsubmissive beings over thousands of years...
task.compass: §d[Nether Exploration]§r Shared Stone Across the Horizon
task.respawn_anchor: §d[Nether Exploration]§r A Cat Has Nine Lives, But a Respawn Anchor Has More
task.respawn_anchor.desc: A relic of the Windless Era? From the fabled star far away? No one knows its origins
task.blaze_rod.desc: These blazing creatures were once human, abandoned in the Nether after the Ancient War and twisted by its corruption--an inevitable foe on your journey
task.wither.desc_1: After the Ancient War, humans fled to a new plane, a bountiful land now known as the Overworld.
task.wither.desc_2: Then Puppetry was born--a delicate art, where Puppeteers poured wisdom into these lifeless crude creations, turning trinkets into loyal human allies.
task.wither.desc_3: Is the Wither not also a product of Puppetry? In terms of power, this is surely the pinnacle of the art...
task.chapter_2.act_3.desc: The traveler's steps have crossed three worlds, thinking the story at an end--yet it is only the true start of the adventure.
task.ender_eye.desc: What lies beyond the firmament, beneath the sea of stars...
task.dragon_breath: §d[End Exploration]§r You Could Use a Mint
task.dragon_breath.desc: The Ender Dragon's venomous spittle, a priceless treasure in the hands of an Alchemist
task.elytra: §d[End Exploration]§r Is the Sky the Limit?
task.elytra.desc: Find the Elytra in the City at the Edge of Adventure
task.ender_dragon: §d[End Exploration]§r Where Beginnings and Ends Converge
task.ender_dragon.desc_1: When the hero slays the Ender Dragon with the fabled sword, heaven crumbles and earth shatters.
task.ender_dragon.desc_2: For adventurers of this land, this is the end of the journey--but for you, it is the true beginning. In this moment, beginnings and ends converge.
task.chapter_1.act_1: §dChapter I·Act I§r Dance of Power and Blood
task.chapter_1.act_1.desc: When the Blood Moon rises, forgotten legends shall awaken once more...
task.summary_of_elven_history.desc: While exploring underground, you discover a peculiar scroll of parchment...
task.imprisoned_wing.desc_1: No one dares to imagine the wails that accompanied its creation eons ago.
task.imprisoned_wing.desc_2: And from it, all learned the visage of a bird with broken wings.
task.bloody_gem.desc_1: A pure white gem sealed a great power, once unleashed by a cursed youth through a bloodied ritual.
task.bloody_gem.desc_2: And so the Bloodstained Gem was born into the world...
task.bloody_gem.tips: Mine Ruby Ore to obtain Rubies
task.bloody_armor.desc_1: O Gods, I offer all I am to claim the full power within this gem
task.bloody_armor.desc_2: The youth prayed, thinking it futile--but a God heard his cry.
task.bloody_armor.desc_3: But was it the God he believed in that answered?
task.decayed_servant.desc_1: Decayed Thralls burrow from the earth, the Divine Edict still echoing in their ears.
task.decayed_servant.desc_2: They see the towering altar, and the crimson wine in its chalices.
task.decayed_servant.desc_3: The youth kneels at the altar's edge, his robes soaked in scarlet petals--yet he is no longer himself.
task.decayed_servant.desc_4: This night, the Blood Moon shall rise.
task.decayed_servant.tips: Seek the Ruby Dungeon underground and defeat the Ruby Zombies within
task.true_and_false.desc_1: By the grand palace, the youth stares at his followers, words failing him.
task.true_and_false.desc_2: Is all of this real... or merely an illusion?
task.true_and_false.tips: Find the Ruby Trial Chamber underground, activate its altar with a Ruby, and defeat the bound guardian
task.thunder_key.desc_1: My lord, with this one-of-a-kind key forged from thunderlight,
task.thunder_key.desc_2: you may seal these treasures away, and punish all who dare to covet them
task.thunder_key.tips: Defeat the bound guardian at the altar to claim the Key of Thunderlight--use it to safely claim the chamber's treasures...
task.blood_gaze.desc_1: One day, thunder rained from the heavens, and his long journey reached its end.
task.blood_gaze.desc_2: In his final moments, did the youth recall that bloodied night at the altar? No one knows.
task.blood_gaze.desc_3: All that is known--his soul, twisted by hatred and resentment, lingers for eternity, condensed into this Crimson Gaze.
task.blood_gaze.tips: Defeat the bound guardian at the altar to claim the Crimson Gaze
task.world_end_fruit: Elysian Fruit of the World's Edge
task.world_end_fruit.desc_1: Legends speak of a divine garden at the very edge of the world.
task.world_end_fruit.desc_2: In an age of strife, a messenger of calamity sailed across endless oceans to reach this land.
task.world_end_fruit.desc_3: Yet all they saw was sky and earth stained red with blood.
task.world_end_fruit.tips: Craft a Ruby Apple with a Ruby and an Apple
task.song_of_power_and_blood.desc_1: Followers fled madly with their lord's corpse to the fallen palace, yet it was no longer their home.
task.song_of_power_and_blood.desc_2: In the end, they hastily buried his body in a humble church, and met their own demise.
task.song_of_power_and_blood.tips: In the Crimson Church, seek the Final Tomb of Thunderlight--activate it with the Crimson Gaze to summon the Ruby Lord
task.chapter_2.act_4.desc: The traveler's steps have crossed three worlds, thinking the story at an end--yet it is only the true start of the adventure.
task.alchemist.desc: A workbench of ancient alchemists, touched by a wisp of arcane magic
task.alchemist.tips: Craft an Alchemy Table with a Ruby and Planks
task.magic_dust.desc: Magical powder said to bestow a Soul upon any object
task.magic_dust.tips: Crush a Ruby to obtain Magic Dust
task.verdant_stone.desc: An extremely rare gem from the depths of the Overworld, unable to be forged directly into tools or weapons
task.infernal_remains.desc: Forged indestructible by immense pressure, one of the mightiest natural materials in existence
task.ancient_war_remains.desc: History was broken by the fifty-year war of the Nether--only these dark charred relics lie silent, proof of what once was...
task.ancient_war_remains.tips: Mine Ancient War Relics in the Nether to obtain Ancient Shards
task.fear_soul.desc: A fractured soul from the End, perhaps it can be put to use...
task.fear_soul.tips: Mine Dreadstone in the End to obtain a Soul of Dread
task.primal_yearning.desc: Legends say when the Divine Punishment fell, a blinding light tore through the sky--midnight became noon in an instant. When it all ended, all of the old world faded to illusion: no sun rose in the east at dawn, noon was as dark as night, summer turned to winter, and winter to an endless frost.
task.primal_yearning.desc_2: And you--you are piecing this old world's fantasy back together, like a broken puzzle.
task.primal_yearning.tips: Combine Magic Dust, Gold Ingots, Ancient Shards, a Soul of Dread and an Emeraldine Stone at the Alchemy Table to craft an Originite Ingot
task.chapter_3.act_1: §dChapter III·Act I§r Wind Rises in the Layered Sands
task.chapter_3.act_1.desc: The denizens trapped between the ice sheets have finally awakened in the vast desert. Seventy thousand days and nights have passed, and the road ahead is long. Where will they go?
task.green_in_sand: A Touch of Green in the Sand Sea
task.green_in_sand.desc: The people of the sand sea have awakened from a long sleep, with dust and the scent of death filling the air.
task.green_in_sand.desc_2: The only green to be seen is this.
task.hard_to_swallow_food.desc: The ancestors of the sand sea tried to cultivate crops, but all failed due to the terrifying nature and ruthless monster particles.
task.hard_to_swallow_food.desc_2: In the end, they had to swallow the hard-to-swallow meat of the monsters.
task.hard_to_swallow_food.tips: Defeat Sandcaust Zombies (Husk) to obtain Sand Meat
task.dry_pot.desc: Fellow citizens, let us sing and dance to thank the gods for their gifts.
task.dry_pot.desc_2: Under the dry riverbed, the ancestors discovered water for the first time.
task.dry_pot.tips: Craft a Desert Flask using Gold Nuggets and Bottles of Water. The Desert Flask can be used to refine potions with beneficial effects with some desert ingredients.
task.god_arrival.desc: At the moonrise, the God of Rain descended from the sky with a 'Divine Oracle'. So--wherever she walked, the sand sea turned into an oasis, and the tears she shed turned into the most precious spring water.
task.god_arrival.desc_2: I grant you permission to take my tears to resist this endless heat, she said.
task.god_arrival.tips: Craft a Cooling Potion using Ice Blocks. You can use it to save your life when you feel thirsty or dehydrated.
task.sacrifice.desc: A kind little rabbit wandered in the layered sands, smelling the fragrant air--the ancestors of the desert were sacrificing to their ancestors.
task.sacrifice.desc_2: When the little rabbit opened its eyes again, its whole body was dyed bright like a poppy.
task.sacrifice.desc_3: But it will be reborn in the flames.
task.sacrifice.tips: Defeat Killer Rabbits or ordinary Rabbits to obtain Rabbit Claws, which can be used to brew Desert Flask of Strength.
task.shattered_sand.desc: Soon, the God of Rain established an empire above the oasis, selecting her most devout believers as emperors of the empire, enfeoffing her followers as temple priests, and spreading civilization to all sides.
task.shattered_sand.desc_2: Looking down, she saw only the loyal warriors of the Drift Sand Empire.
task.shattered_sand.tips: Defeat Drift Sand Soldiers to obtain Shattered Sand Staff
task.key_of_contract: The Key of Contract, Divine Power, and Wealth
task.key_of_contract.desc: Led by the God of Rain, the Drift Sand Empire eventually spread civilization and prosperity to the sand sea, accumulating infinite wealth.
task.key_of_contract.desc_2: "I use the divine power as a key to grant you that your private property will not be violated forever."
task.key_of_contract.tips: Defeat Drift Sand Monsters to obtain Drift Sand Key. The Drift Sand Key can be used to open the Drift Sand Cabinet which treasures in the ruins.
task.blessing_of_rain: The Blessing of the God of Rain
task.blessing_of_rain.desc: The God of Rain's clear teardrops, which were granted to the soldiers after the war subsided.
task.blessing_of_rain.desc_2: I also use my divine power to ensure that you and your children will never suffer from drought again.
task.blessing_of_rain.tips: DefeatDrift Sand Sergeants to obtain Divine Blessing: Divine Rainfall. Using it can temporarily immunize you from drought and dehydration effects.
task.kingdom_fall: The Fall of the Old Kingdom Again
task.kingdom_fall.desc: Not long after the empire stabilized, the second "God" in the starry sky descended to the world.
task.kingdom_fall.desc_2: Carried civilization to the remnants of the past.
task.kingdom_fall.tips: Seek out the "Anonymous Tomb" in the desert to obtain the Heart of the Desert.
task.statue_of_past: Statue of the Past Layered Sands
task.statue_of_past.desc: These statues were originally used to praise the merits of the God of Rain and the Pharaoh, but that night, they began to emit a strange glow...
task.statue_of_past.tips: The Layered Sands Statue is crafted from Diamond, Gold, Heart of the Desert, and Past Building Materials.
task.symbol_of_life.desc: The people in the Kingdom were awakened to find that their god's body had cracked and the Pharaoh had died a tragic death in the palace.
task.symbol_of_life.desc_2: Although the old kingdom fell again, the mad poet still sang:
task.symbol_of_life.desc_4: "Return the Rebirth Symbol to its place."
task.symbol_of_life.tips: Obtain the Symbol of Life from the "Anonymous Tomb", then craft the Rebirth Symbol using Gold, Diamond, Symbol of Life, and Heart of the Desert.
task.rain_in_sand: Drizzling Rain in the Sand Sea
task.rain_in_sand.desc: Without the god's protection, the once paradise turned into a graveyard. The Nilotes wandering in the sand sea gradually suffered from sand erosion, the empire's army became unconscious monsters, and the vast sand sea once again covered itself with the veil of death...
task.rain_in_sand.desc_2: The Nilotic Empire has thus fallen.
task.rain_in_sand.tips: Find the 'Earth Altar' in the desert, return the Resurrection Symbol to the altar inside to start the challenge.
task.chapter_3.act_2.desc: Sacramento, though long gone with the river of time, is known to everyone living in the New Gathering Age--here was the capital of the former Nilotic Empire, and also the place of joy and sorrow for the explorers of that time.
task.gold_in_sand.desc_1: After the fall of the Layered Sands Empire, all the treasures of the ancient Nilotes gradually sank into the sand...
task.gold_in_sand.desc_2: And these sands seem to be cursed, making it impossible for later generations to directly wash the gold out of the fine sand.
task.gold_in_sand.tips: Use the Alchemy Table to convert Gold Sand into Gold Nuggets
task.curse_of_sand.desc_2: The puppets who come to this sand sea will also suffer my curse.
task.curse_of_sand.desc_3: When they dig for the treasures here, they will only find handfuls of worthless yellow sand;
task.curse_of_sand.desc_4: The earth will also give birth to poisonous insects for them...
task.story_of_gold: The Story of Gold Panning in the Sand
task.story_of_gold.desc_1: Although the world was almost destroyed, in the new world transformed from the sand sea, farming, cold and heat, winter and summer, day and night go on forever, allowing humans and the Undead to survive.
task.story_of_gold.desc_2: Later, the new king of humans sent his minister Karnavon to the sand sea to find the treasures left by the old civilization...
task.story_of_gold.tips: Obtain the scattered letter: The Story of Gold Panning in the Sand from the Explorer Camp to learn about the story after the fall of the Nilotic Empire.
task.ancient_myth.desc_1: Ninety-nine days after Karnavon's departure, a magnificent ruin in the sand sea was excavated, filled with countless treasures and gold.
task.ancient_myth.desc_2: The king named it Sacramento, the same name as the legendary first place where gold was found--and then Karnavon discovered Osiris, the tomb of the Nilotic Empire Pharaoh, in the barren land of the Valley of the Kings.
task.ancient_myth.desc_3: He pried open the tomb and saw a sentence in the ancient myth collection:
task.ancient_myth.desc_4: Whoever disturbs the Pharaoh's sleep will have the wings of death descend upon their head.
task.ancient_myth.desc_6: Whoever enters this tomb with impure thoughts will have their neck strangled like a bird.
task.ancient_myth.tips: Buy ancient Nilotic myths from desert merchants
task.sign_of_mutation.desc_1: After the ancient war, countless dead souls wandered the world, harming all living things. Potiphera, an ordinary assistant priest, learned of the discovery in the Valley of the Kings and rushed there.
task.sign_of_mutation.desc_2: The underground laboratory glowed with an otherworldly light, and a species unknown to this land was born.
task.sign_of_mutation.tips: Seek out the 'Mutated Laboratory' underground and defeat the Scorpions inside.
task.palace_of_gods: The Palace of the Three Gods and the Son of Man
task.palace_of_gods.desc_1: In Nilotic legend, the 'Three Primordial Gods' and Osiris, the Son of Man, once built a magnificent palace, which was also buried in yellow sand along with the empire when it fell.
task.palace_of_gods.desc_2: As time passed, all the creations of the empire above the dust had returned to dust, and only a corner of this underground palace still existed in the world under the influence of the 'Light Mystic Art'...
task.palace_of_gods.desc_3: So Potiphera stepped into the palace, wanting to unlock the secret of this mystic art.
task.palace_of_gods.tips: Seek out the 'Corner of the Underground Palace' underground in the desert, activate the 'Anonymous Tomb' with the Layered Sands Crown to summon the BOSS - The Wrath of the Creator. Defeat the BOSS to obtain the God of Rain Crown.
task.eye_of_sand_erosion.desc_2: People do not know where the mutation came from, but they know that--like the desert people a thousand years ago who lost the gods' protection, countless monsters emerged from the ground.
task.eye_of_sand_erosion.desc_3: This is the third disaster that humanity faces after the ancient wars and the various disasters.
task.eye_of_sand_erosion.tips: Defeat Sand Erosion Spiders to obtain Sand Erosion Spider Eyes, which can be used to brew one type of Desert Flask.
task.babel_sand.desc: "Come, let us build ourselves a city, with a tower that reaches to the heavens, so that we may make a name for ourselves and not be scattered over the face of the whole earth."

article.hiddenyears:1.title: A Journey of a Thousand Miles and the Path Beneath Your Feet
article.hiddenyears:1.body_1: The age of past prosperity is fading away, and we, who once laughed together, shall turn to dust.
article.hiddenyears:1.body_2: In this lonely world, you are perhaps the only intelligent being left. Sadly, I cannot explain to you in full what has happened -- you only need to know for now that you are a survivor of the 'Anomaly', sent here to build a new world.
article.hiddenyears:1.body_3: Our old homeland has fallen. Countless storms have turned solid stone into sand. You were meant to grow in safety, yet you must now walk through the storm. Here and now, a vast world awaits your exploration. Of the past and future, history shall be written by you.
article.hiddenyears:2.title: Song of the Hidden Ones
article.hiddenyears:2.body: The Undying wrote prayers to their deity beneath the first eclipse of the moon.
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_1.title: The Re-Creation
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_1.body_1: Rock layers blocked the blue sky.
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_1.body_11: But those who rebel shall weep in hell for eternity.
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_1.body_12: Those who dance in the air,
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_1.body_13: those who bathe in the water,
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_1.body_14: those who dwell in the woods --
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_1.body_15: they are the seeds sown by Ernevanga.
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_1.body_16: Sun, moon, cold and heat cycle endlessly.
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_1.body_18: The Undying Man -- so they call Him.
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_2.title: The Book of Destruction
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_2.body_2: fell in a pool of blood beneath the moonlit night.
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_2.body_3: Smoke filled the air; war was imminent.
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_2.body_4: And so fire was first kindled,
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_2.body_7: Fifty years passed in this way.
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_2.body_9: the world lay in ruins, on the brink of collapse.
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_2.body_10: At the moment of ruin, Ernevanga sent down a miracle once more.
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_2.body_11: Those who would leave, leave at once.
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_2.body_12: Those who would stay, fall into hell.
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_2.body_13: The last surviving Undying Man stepped into the cycle of reincarnation.
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_2.body_14: From then on, no one remembered
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_3.title: The Book of Rebirth
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_3.body_4: pierces black clouds accumulated over a thousand years.
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_3.body_5: Mountains and rivers adorn this land,
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_3.body_6: birds and beasts walk through the woods.
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_3.body_9: this is the Overworld, a new home.
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_3.body_10: This world was never meant to be like this.
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_3.body_12: and I will lead you to a place of true freedom.
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_3.body_13: So said Claudius. He has betrayed the one who granted us freedom.
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_3.body_15: and He shall no longer have the power to spare the mortal world from disaster.
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_3.body_17: that the Undying would live forever in the Netherworld,
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_3.body_18: that the boundless universe would reveal all its secrets openly.
article.hiddenyears:2.chapter_3.body_19: But this was nothing more than a fantasy...
article.hiddenyears:3.title: Abstract of Elven History
article.hiddenyears:3.body_2: A thousand years ago, a star in the sky suddenly flickered for no reason...
article.hiddenyears:3.body_3: Then the God of Freedom descended upon this world. Legend says that at that moment, the world split into three realms, and the Dark Dragon was born -- but in truth, none of us know what really happened. At this point, 'history' is no longer history.
article.hiddenyears:3.body_4: This is known as the Fracture.
article.hiddenyears:3.body_6: Prodeter, or the God of the Undying, awakened the followers from before the Fracture. They had once followed the God of Freedom together, and the God of Freedom would bless them all with immortality.
article.hiddenyears:3.body_7: Meanwhile, the seeds sown by Freedom took root in the deepest planes, giving birth to modern humans. Born alongside humanity was our race: the Elves.
article.hiddenyears:3.body_9: No records remain of the fifty-year war. All history ended there. All we know is that in the end, the human homeland became an eternal blazing land, melting all who dared to uncover that past...
article.hiddenyears:3.body_10: And so we left our homeland -- the Deep Plane, now known as the Nether. To return there today is to see only an endless sea of lava and blood-red stone that symbolizes death.
article.hiddenyears:3.body_12: Although the world was nearly destroyed, humanity managed to settle and thrive in their new home. But when the truth was revealed, that long era of prosperity came to an end.
article.hiddenyears:3.body_13: The Undying Legions defeated their own kin -- the one later known as the Ruby King -- and began to expand. Eventually, they turned their claws toward us.
article.hiddenyears:3.body_15: We were all conquered by the Undying, by the Calamity, becoming part of their grand plan -- a dishonorable part. The age of the Elves has ended.
article.hiddenyears:3.body_16: But even in chains, there still survive those who remain.
article.hiddenyears:3.body_17: The sound of a crossbow being drawn comes from nearby. I must stop writing here.
article.hiddenyears:4.title: The Blood-Stained Corundum
article.hiddenyears:4.body_2: a pure white gem sealed the power of the desert.
article.hiddenyears:4.body_3: Korn and his younger brother coveted it.
article.hiddenyears:4.body_8: In the eyes of the innocent, before infinite power,
article.hiddenyears:4.body_10: I offer my wealth, my kin, and my life
article.hiddenyears:4.body_11: in exchange for all the power within this gem.
article.hiddenyears:4.body_12: Rotten servants burst forth from the earth.
article.hiddenyears:4.body_13: The Divine Oracle still echoes in their ears.
article.hiddenyears:4.body_15: crimson offerings piled carelessly in a golden altar,
article.hiddenyears:4.body_16: and holy flowers soaked in red wine.
article.hiddenyears:4.body_17: Our Lord, with this key forged from lightning,
article.hiddenyears:4.body_18: may your treasures remain sealed, and the greedy be punished.
article.hiddenyears:4.body_19: Upon his head rested a crown made of wine -- blood.
article.hiddenyears:4.body_20: Before his eyes lay the boundless earth.
article.hiddenyears:4.body_22: Was all of this real, or an illusion?
article.hiddenyears:4.body_24: Truthseeker -- the sword of his friend -- pierced his heart, which no longer beat.
article.hiddenyears:4.body_25: Mad followers carried their master’s corpse
article.hiddenyears:4.body_27: but it was no longer their home.
article.hiddenyears:4.body_28: Beside the fallen blood-red cathedral stood Claudius, the Godslayer.
article.hiddenyears:4.body_29: He buried his companion, Korn, who had fallen into madness.
article.hiddenyears:4.body_30: It was he who had freed his friend.
article.hiddenyears:5.title: Exploring the Sacrificial City I
article.hiddenyears:5.body_1: This is a page torn from the journal of an adventurer during the Calamity Age.
article.hiddenyears:5.body_2: Following the mine tunnel, I reached this dead city. The way in was clear, but seawater had flooded the path back. Torches and rails were destroyed.
article.hiddenyears:5.body_3: I hate underground cities -- dark, cramped, twisted, and eerie. Lights cannot pierce those strange black materials that glow with living blue-green spots.
article.hiddenyears:5.body_4: Though I saw no monsters breeding in the dark, I held my shield high and planted a torch every few steps.
article.hiddenyears:5.body_5: The children are still asleep. Do not wake them.
article.hiddenyears:5.body_6: It was an old woman’s voice.
article.hiddenyears:5.body_7: I turned around. A small, thin figure without armor stood behind me. She held out an empty hand.
article.hiddenyears:5.body_8: I extended my shield-arm to shake it -- her skin-and-bones hand was unnaturally hard.
article.hiddenyears:5.body_9: Her skin was smooth as terracotta, yet she seemed stronger than me.
article.hiddenyears:5.body_10: Trembling, I followed her to a dim blue campfire and sat.
article.hiddenyears:5.body_11: I saw her calcite-colored skin stretched tight over sharp bones. The faint fire cast thin, uneven shadows onto the dark blue tuff walls.
article.hiddenyears:5.body_12: She suddenly spoke: How goes the world above?
article.hiddenyears:5.body_13: Terrible. War is everywhere. That’s why I came to this damned place.
article.hiddenyears:5.body_14: I see. Still war between humans and the Undying? In time,
article.hiddenyears:5.body_15: the land you live on will become seabed ruins buried by sand. The stone hills around you will be covered in soil,
article.hiddenyears:5.body_16: and new oaks, birches, spruces, jungles, and cherry trees will grow...
article.hiddenyears:5.body_17: Cherry trees? I’ve never seen one. They went extinct a thousand years ago... How do you know about them?
article.hiddenyears:5.body_18: Before I could finish, my head grew heavy, and I blacked out.
article.hiddenyears:5.body_19: Because I ferry the souls of all who perish in war, she said with a faint smile.
article.hiddenyears:6.title: Brief History of Eras -- Part One
article.hiddenyears:6.body_2: On the first day, the God from among the stars descended upon the primordial land. And so the Windless Age ended.
article.hiddenyears:6.body_3: He opened the window of civilization for us. We dare not speak His true name. Ernevanga -- even reversed, we may only utter it once.
article.hiddenyears:6.body_5: The world bowed to the Lord from beyond. It split into three parts, covered in ice and snow.
article.hiddenyears:6.body_7: Koxilo, King of Men, built an altar to Gavanel. He offered clean livestock and birds as burnt offerings. The Lord smelled the sweet aroma and gave Koxilo the Heavenly Throne, allowing him to rule the world.
article.hiddenyears:6.body_8: Until the earth cracked seven times, the Son of Man fell from the sky. Then Kozdemu ascended the throne and exiled the princess, his sister.
article.hiddenyears:6.body_10: Funeral songs echoed across the kingdom. The King fell again. The enraged Men turned their weapons against Prodeter and his vassals.
article.hiddenyears:6.body_11: The gate to the Overworld opened; the path to rebirth was made. Only the stubborn would be left in purgatory.
article.hiddenyears:6.body_13: You shall not decay, nor be defiled, nor fade away. The Master of Stars spoke to Pierre, the new King of Men in the Overworld.
article.hiddenyears:6.body_14: Pierre followed the Lord’s teachings and built a paradise on earth in the Overworld.
article.hiddenyears:6.body_16: I will reveal the truth to you and build a godless nation.
article.hiddenyears:6.body_17: Then I shall wipe the false gods from the sky and the undying Judas
article.hiddenyears:7.title: Brief History of Eras -- Part Two
article.hiddenyears:7.body_2: Warriors forgot why they fought. Those who should not perish fell from the stars.
article.hiddenyears:7.body_3: On earth, lives were ruined again.
article.hiddenyears:7.body_5: The power that burst forth was the same as that of the Dark Dragon.
article.hiddenyears:7.body_6: The world became hell... and the Undying Men met their end.
article.hiddenyears:7.body_8: (Much of the text is damaged beyond recognition)
article.hiddenyears:8.title: Priest’s Record I
article.hiddenyears:8.body_1: Recorded at the beginning of the Eclipse Era
article.hiddenyears:8.body_3: Voice 2: We’ve begun, Mr. Closier. Everything we say will be recorded.
article.hiddenyears:8.body_4: Closier: What have you done to those monsters? Catching them cost me a great deal. Killing them is easy, but capturing them is not. And I’m just a hunter -- why did you call me here?
article.hiddenyears:8.body_5: Voice 2: Do you know how to keep monsters from crawling back underground?
article.hiddenyears:8.body_6: Closier: With names. With a name, one will not be forgotten. Without being forgotten, one will not vanish.
article.hiddenyears:8.body_7: Voice 1: That is exactly why we summoned you. You are an experienced monster hunter. If you help us find a way to control them, perhaps we can end this disaster.
article.hiddenyears:8.body_8: Closier (chuckling dryly): Spare me such words. The last one who could control monsters was some Ko-something from a fairy tale. Even the one who killed him has been dead for nearly a hundred years.
article.hiddenyears:8.body_9: Voice 2: Then tell us about your experience fighting monsters. For example, do they wear human armor?
article.hiddenyears:8.body_10: Closier: Legends say the Undying turn into monster-like beings during eclipses -- so-called zombies. Before the disaster, that was just a story to you. I’ve seen it two or three times.
article.hiddenyears:8.body_11: Closier: Back then, zombies were far less aggressive. Everyone said they were stupid, and they turned back into normal Undying during the day, so no one feared them.
article.hiddenyears:8.body_12: Closier: But compared to monsters, I think zombies are intelligent. I throw them fine chestplates and swords, and they pick them up to fight me.
article.hiddenyears:8.body_13: Closier: This shows zombies still have intelligence -- more than those monsters, anyway.
article.hiddenyears:8.body_14: Voice 2: Do you remember the legend?
article.hiddenyears:8.body_16: Voice 1: At the end of the Windless Era, the sky fell and the earth split. Dark power erupted from the world, forming a wicked dragon. The scattered dark power and some ancient humans became the ancestors of monsters.
article.hiddenyears:8.body_17: Voice 2: Do not forget: ancient humans, the Undying, and the Calamity kin share the same origin.
article.hiddenyears:8.body_18: Closier: A bit off-topic, don’t you think? We can set aside the legends for now. I can’t control monsters, but I can catch a few zombies for your research, so this disaster ends sooner.
article.hiddenyears:8.body_19: Voice 1 (short silence): Very well, Mr. Closier. Thank you for your cooperation. We hope you will bring us several test subjects soon.
article.hiddenyears:8.body_20: Voice 1 (after Closier leaves): From what we’ve heard, perhaps dark power possesses the Undying and turns them into zombies. But why do they revert during the day...
article.hiddenyears:8.body_21: Voice 2: Could it be because of the Blessing of Immortality?
article.hiddenyears:8.body_22: Voice 1: Then the fact that zombies can no longer revert... could it be...
article.hiddenyears:9.title: The Tale of Gold in the Sand
article.hiddenyears:9.body_2: Shocking news came from the vast desert: the vanguard of the Holy Veil Kingdom had found countless treasures in the Sacramento Ruins of ancient Nilot! They say adventurers who went there returned rich. Tomorrow I shall join them to seek fortune!
article.hiddenyears:9.body_4: Today I reached San Francis City. It is not far from the desert. The fever for treasure and gold has swept the city -- nearly all shops are closed. Farmers pawned their land, laborers abandoned their tools, all rushing to the Sacramento Ruins.
article.hiddenyears:9.body_5: I can’t help but worry: will there be any valuable treasures left by the time I arrive?
article.hiddenyears:9.body_7: A new year has come. Back home, snow would be falling by now. I finally reached the Sacramento Ruins. The legendary buried treasure has been picked clean. The place is overcrowded with adventurers. Food and shelter are suddenly scarce. My savings are running out. What should I do...
article.hiddenyears:9.body_9: A local merchant arranged for me to work in a mine, hoping to earn enough to get home soon. I saw desert mines for the first time -- rich in copper, iron, coal, and even sand with flecks of gold.
article.hiddenyears:9.body_11: Chaos broke out underground. As a coworker mined ore, a dark brown venomous insect burst from beneath his feet. Then XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX. I need a new job. If I stay... it’s not worth losing my life.
article.hiddenyears:9.body_13: The foreman called priests from the Sacrificial City. They said the accident happened because the dead worker had offended the gods, angering heaven. But at midnight, I heard the foreman and priests talking about the Curse of XXX, the Fall of IXXs.
article.hiddenyears:9.body_14: Their voices were low, but I heard the last sentence clearly: We can use this blazing power from the desert to XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX.
article.hiddenyears:9.body_15: The journal ends here. A death certificate is tucked inside: John Sutter, aged 27, died after falling into a river valley while drunk on the night of 29th January, 2254.
article.hiddenyears:10.title: Nilotic Myths
article.hiddenyears:10.body_2: The incarnation of the sun awoke from chaos. A voice echoed in his mind:
article.hiddenyears:10.body_3: Mutuan, incarnation of the sun, awake...
article.hiddenyears:10.body_4: With the secret art of light, He created the world. He gave a portion of His power to form the Sun, and its shadow became the Moon.
article.hiddenyears:10.body_5: But at that time, no life existed. All was endless desert. Sun and moon rose and fell without order, and life could not multiply.
article.hiddenyears:10.body_7: On the second day, heaven sent Kah, the ruler of power. Seeing the endless desert, He wished to help Mutuan.
article.hiddenyears:10.body_8: So Kah established Order. The Sun and Moon refused to obey at first, but Kah’s power forced them to submit.
article.hiddenyears:10.body_9: At last, the cycle of sun and moon became orderly, and life had a chance to flourish.
article.hiddenyears:10.body_11: Mutuan rejoiced to see the sun and moon submit to Order. He invited Kah to drink wine together.
article.hiddenyears:10.body_12: When they were drunk, monsters were born into the world. When they sobered, civilization thrived.
article.hiddenyears:10.body_14: In those days, the desert was ruled by a King.
article.hiddenyears:10.body_15: The King had slaves slaughtered in the desert. His priests held staffs made of human bones and offered the slaves’ blood to Mutuan and Kah, begging them not to drink and bring disaster.
article.hiddenyears:10.body_16: Mutuan and Kah created Isis, to guide humanity toward the right path.
article.hiddenyears:10.body_18: When the moon rose, Isis descended from the sky with a divine oracle.
article.hiddenyears:10.body_19: Where she walked, desert turned to oasis. Her tears became the most precious springs in the world. Civilization no longer rose or fell with the drunkenness of the two gods.
article.hiddenyears:10.body_21: Isis built an empire upon the oasis. She chose Osiris, her most devout follower, as emperor. She made her followers priests of the temple, and spread civilization across the lands.
article.hiddenyears:10.body_22: This was the beginning of the Nilotic Empire.
article.hiddenyears:10.body_24: To lead humanity to goodness, Isis used the secret art of light to create the boundary between life and death, then sealed this power somewhere in the yellow sand.
article.hiddenyears:10.body_25: From then on, the dead of the Nilotic Empire were judged in the underground corridors of the Grand Hall. If found worthy, they would go to a heavenly paradise called the Reed Fields.
article.hiddenyears:10.body_26: Once there, they would live in peace with their beloved ones and begin anew.
article.hiddenyears:11.title: Discovery Record of Sacramento
article.hiddenyears:11.body_1: (Fuzzy records, only some parts can be clearly seen)
article.hiddenyears:11.body_3: The God declared unto the King of the Holy Veil... that He had long ago destroyed the remnants of the old civilization in the sand sea... So the King sent us to the desert to seek the treasures left by the ancient world...
article.hiddenyears:11.body_5: A magnificent ruin was discovered in the sand sea, filled with countless treasures and gold... The King named it 'Sacramento', the very same name as the place where gold first appeared in legend.
article.hiddenyears:11.body_7: Most of the treasures of Sacramento were offered to our King, yet some were sealed by a strange power. To approach them rashly would only harm the innocent... I proposed that we leave these treasures here... and gather warriors from across the realm to break the seals...
article.hiddenyears:11.body_9: Warriors from every land flooded into Sacramento... Yet most returned empty-handed, and some who had traveled far did not even have the coin to go home...
article.hiddenyears:11.body_11: A horrific tragedy occurred in the mines of Sacramento... Priests arrived to calm the terrified miners, only to accidentally discover a way to wield this ancient power...
article.hiddenyears:11.body_13: An unnamed tomb was found in a desolate land known as the 'Valley of Kings'. When opened, it revealed... the remains of... one anointed by Isis... The body was perfectly preserved, as if it had only just passed away... We forged papers for him, disguised him as an adventurer who died in the desert, and sent him to the royal city for study...
article.hiddenyears:11.body_15: A breakthrough was made in the study of the remains... The ancient power of Sacramento was finally turned into the power of echoes, used by the Sacrificial City to separate life and death and command reincarnation... Though several innocent miners lost their lives because of it... the crisis was averted...
article.hiddenyears:11.body_17: We were all wrong... That power from XXXX... can never be tamed by priests...

howtoplay.hiddenyears:material.title: Materials
howtoplay.hiddenyears:material.wooden: -§eWood Planks§r are the most fundamental material, obtainable without any tools--though they face the fate of being discarded.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:material.bone: -§eBones§r are a natural material acquired by defeating monsters or livestock, with slightly better performance than wood.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:material.stone: -§eStone§r is an abundant and durable material. In a certain otherworld, you can even compress cobblestones into something far more robust...
howtoplay.hiddenyears:material.refined_r: -§eRefined Rock§r is smelted from stone, netherrack, or end stone. Undoubtedly, its durability surpasses ordinary stone.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:material.copper: -§eCopper§r is a widely distributed metal material. Unlike its corresponding block, copper tools and weapons do not 'rust' over time.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:material.silver: -§eMithril§r is the most precious and tough material before diamonds, mined from mithril ore underground.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:material.diamond: -§eDiamond§r is a well-known, hard blue gemstone, extremely rare.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:material.crystal: -§eMagic Crystal§r is renowned for its exceptional enchanting power, obtained by smelting amethyst shards.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:material.netherite: -§eNetherite§r is an alloy forged by combining netherite scraps and gold ingots.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:material.originite: -§eOrigin Alloy§r is the most powerful material in the world, forged by blending materials from three dimensions.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:material.nugget_an: Nuggets and dust can be obtained by decomposing materials in a crafting table or grinding them in a crusher.
These fragments can be used for crafting. Additionally, coal nuggets and dust serve as fuel with a longer total burning time.
A forging machine crafted with 4 wood planks and 2 iron nuggets.
The crusher grinds all materials into nuggets or dust, with a slight production boost.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:material_basic.bod: §lWood, Bone§r and §lStone§r are easily accessible and fundamental materials for crafting tools and weapons.
Wood and stone are collected from blocks; bones are dropped by monsters or livestock.
§lCopper§r is a widely distributed metal material. Unlike its corresponding block, copper tools and weapons do not 'rust' over time.
Copper ore is mined underground; copper nuggets are obtained by smelting copper ore.
§lRefined Rock§r is a special material smelted from stone, netherrack, or end stone.
It crafts stronger tools and weapons, with performance slightly inferior to iron.
§lMithril§r is a precious and tough material, mined from mithril ore underground.
Mithril ore generates between layers -64 and 40. Mine and smelt it to obtain mithril ingots.
§lDiamond§r is a rare material for crafting high-tier tools, armor, and enchanting tables.
Diamond ore is mined underground; diamond nuggets are obtained by smelting diamonds.
§lMagic Crystal§r is an extremely rare material for crafting enchanted tools and weapons with unparalleled enchanting power.
Mining amethyst blocks or clusters has a low chance of dropping Enchanted Amethyst Shards. Smelt these shards to get Magic Crystal Ingots.
§lOrigin Alloy§r is the most powerful material in the game, forged by blending materials from three dimensions.
Forge Origin Alloy in an Alchemy Table using the following materials:
§lGold Ingot§r: Core material, smelted from raw gold ore
§lMagic Dust§r: Infuses the alloy with a 'soul', obtained by decomposing rubies
§lJadeite Stone§r: A rare gem from the Overworld, generating below layer 10
§lNether Shard§r: Harvested from the Nether's harshest, hottest, darkest, and most dangerous regions by smelting ancient debris
§lFearful Soul§r: A fragmented soul from the End, mined from Fear Stone
Craft powerful tools, weapons, and armor--far surpassing other materials in performance.
Additionally, combine Origin Alloy with other materials to unlock extra functions.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:tools_weapons.saw: -§eSaw§r is an excellent tool for gathering wood. Faster than axes at chopping logs, it also yields extra rewards--additional sticks, planks, or even whole logs.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:tools_weapons.crow: -§eCrowbar§r specializes in mining metal blocks, more efficient than pickaxes. It also has a chance to drop extra metal nuggets. Craft it with 2 metal ingots and 1 corresponding metal nugget.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:tools_weapons.heav: -§eHeavy Hammer§r is a miner's best friend. While slightly less damaging, it has twice the durability of regular pickaxes. Highly efficient for mining stone and ore, it drops extra cobblestones and raw ore.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:tools_weapons.dagg: -§eDagger§r is lightweight yet deadly--dealing far more damage than swords, though less durable. Ideal for fast attacks but cannot be enchanted. Craft with 1 material and 1 stick.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:tools_weapons.war_: -§eWar Hammer§r is a heavy weapon with immense damage and decent durability. Though heavier than regular swords, it delivers devastating blows.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:magic.title: Magic
howtoplay.hiddenyears:magic.basic.title: Magic Basics
howtoplay.hiddenyears:magic.basic.para1: §eMagic Dust§r is the foundation of all magic recipes, obtained by decomposing rubies. §eMagic Essence§r is a higher-tier material, crafted by combining Magic Dust and Gold Ingots in an Alchemy Table.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:magic.basic.para2: In the magical world, you need three essential functional blocks:
howtoplay.hiddenyears:magic.basic.para3: §eAlchemy Table§r: Your first magical tool for processing basic materials, crafted with rubies and wood planks; §eMagic Brewing Stand§r: Made with Magic Essence and stone in a crafting table, used to brew magical potions; §eMagic Forge§r: Crafted with Magic Essence and iron ingots, the place to forge high-tier equipment.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:magic.teleport.par: §eReturn Shard§r and §eHometown Gem§r are an adventurer's best friends. Craft a Return Shard with an Ender Pearl and Magic Dust in an Alchemy Table to return to manually bound waypoints.
Craft a Hometown Gem with Lapis Lazuli and Magic Essence in an Alchemy Table to instantly return to your spawn point.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:magic.potion.title: Magic Potions
howtoplay.hiddenyears:magic.potion.para1: The Magic Brewing Stand creates various magical potions. Brew a base potion with Magic Essence, then add different materials to unlock special effects.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:magic.potion.para2: Each potion serves a unique purpose--some boost your abilities, others help you survive harsh environments.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:magic.alchemy.para: The Alchemy Table allows material transmutation: Iron to Mithril, Mithril to Diamond, Diamond to Magic Crystal, and finally Magic Crystal to Netherite.
These transmutations require corresponding Magic Essence as a catalyst. Higher-tier material transmutations demand more Magic Essence.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:magic.armor.title: Magical Equipment
howtoplay.hiddenyears:magic.armor.para1: The Magic Forge lets you craft various powerful, special materials.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:magic.armor.para2: For example, combine Copper Ingots with Shining Stone to get Shining Copper Ingots--essential for crafting high-tier equipment.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:magic.armor.para3: The Magic Forge's greatest function is upgrading equipment. If you have Origin Alloy tools, weapons, or armor, enhance them with special materials: add Cold Steel Ingots for more durable Cold Steel equipment; add Glowing Gold Ingots for ultra-fast mining Glowing Gold tools.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:magic.armor.para4: For Netherite and Origin Alloy equipment, add special effects via the Magic Forge: Shining Copper Ingots grant the Shining Copper effect; Corruption Totems grant the Corruption effect.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:magic.armor.para5: These effects appear in the equipment description, making your gear truly unique.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:magic.tips.title: Useful Tips
howtoplay.hiddenyears:magic.tips.para1: Carry various potions for different situations while exploring. Teleportation gems enable fast travel, and magically enhanced equipment boosts your combat power. Always collect magical materials--they're invaluable for crafting high-tier items.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:magic.tips.para2: Precious materials hide in every corner of the magical world. Keep an adventurous spirit to discover more amazing recipes and items. As you delve deeper, you'll craft increasingly powerful magical items and become a true Master Mage.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:brewing.title: Brewing
howtoplay.hiddenyears:brewing.complex.pa: -§eCompound Potion§r is a special magical elixir with multiple simultaneous effects--unlike regular potions with single benefits. Imagine having Invisibility, Speed, and Strength all at once? Compound Potions make it possible!
First, craft a Magic Brewing Stand with cobblestone and Magic Essence.
Different materials add unique effects: Bricks for Invisibility, Glowstone Dust for Glow, Gold Ingots for Strength, and more...
To brew: First create a Compound Potion Base with Magic Essence in a regular Brewing Stand, then place the base in the Magic Brewing Stand.
Next, add your desired effect materials and let the brewing complete.
The best Compound Potions come from bold experimentation and creativity. Explore, experiment, and discover your perfect recipe!
howtoplay.hiddenyears:brewing.desert.par: -§eDesert Flask§r is an indispensable tool for desert exploration, helping you survive harsh desert environments.

Crafting a Basic Desert Flask is simple: place a regular potion and 1 gold nugget in a Brewing Stand. This base flask is the starting point for all special desert potions--like a blank canvas waiting for your creative touch.
Each special potion serves a unique purpose for different scenarios. Generally, these potions require desert-specific ingredients and a Basic Desert Flask.
Carry various potions during desert exploration: use Cooling Tea to beat the daytime heat, Strength Flask for combat, and Sustenance Flask to restore stamina during long journeys.
Use these potions wisely to make your desert adventure safer and more enjoyable.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:artifacts.title: Artifacts
howtoplay.hiddenyears:artifacts.para1: -§eArtifacts§r are powerful in-game equipment that provide unique stat boosts and special effects. Here are the main ways to obtain these precious items:
howtoplay.hiddenyears:artifacts.para2: Artifacts can be found in chests worldwide. Underground palaces in deserts, ancient ruins, and special structures like Elf Prisons are excellent hunting grounds.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:artifacts.para3: Defeating powerful enemies or bosses also yields artifacts--such as the Ruby King, Pharaoh's Apparition, and 'Creator's Wrath'. Prepare thoroughly before challenging these foes.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:artifacts.para4: Additionally, the fastest way to obtain artifacts is through challenges in the §e'Ancient Trial Grounds'§r. To participate, first activate the §e'Ancient Trial Stone'§r inside, defeat the monsters to earn §e'Contract Gems'§r, then exchange the gems for artifact rewards at the Ancient Trial Stone.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:artifacts.para5: Different artifact slots require specific types of artifacts. Equip the right combination to maximize your character's power. Good luck on your artifact-hunting journey!
howtoplay.hiddenyears:jobs.title: Classes
howtoplay.hiddenyears:jobs.para1: -§eClasses§r are a unique ability system. Each class has exclusive skills and traits, letting you experience the game world in different ways.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:jobs.para2: Classes are divided into two categories: Basic and Advanced. Basic Classes include Warrior, Archer, Pastor, and Mage--each with a distinct combat style and role. Advanced Classes unlock only after mastering the corresponding Basic Class.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:jobs.para3: At the start, the game grants you a 'Wanderer's Gem' to unlock your initial class: Wanderer. Upgrade classes using 'Unified Currency'. When a class reaches max level, you can advance to a higher-tier class.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:jobs.para4: Each Basic Class has 10 levels to explore (Advanced Classes go up to 15). As you level up, your existing skills grow stronger. Each class has 2 unique skills triggered by specific items.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:jobs.para5: Every class offers a unique playstyle and role: Warriors excel at close combat, Archers at long-range attacks, Pastors at team support, and Mages at wielding mysterious magical power. Choose a class that fits your playstyle to make your adventure more exciting.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:jobs.para6: Find your perfect class and enjoy the adventure in this world!
article.adventurer_note.chapter_2.title: Character Story 1
article.adventurer_note.chapter_2.body1: You wander the land, gathering resources and crafting items, falling into deep slumber as night falls.
article.adventurer_note.chapter_2.body2: Until that day--decayed enemies burrow from the earth, attacking you relentlessly. Caught off guard, you are defeated time and again, until the morning sun rises, its light incinerating the corrupt creatures...
article.adventurer_note.chapter_2.body3: You realize this world is far from as simple as it seems.
article.adventurer_note.chapter_3.title: Character Story 2
article.adventurer_note.chapter_3.body1: You discover you are not alone--friendly villagers in hamlets and hostile Illagers still linger on the land. Yet they seem to have lost their sanity, only able to let out infantile whimpers.
article.adventurer_note.chapter_3.body2: You trade with the villagers to obtain Legendary Tome, and battle Illagers to seize their Totems. Following the river of time upstream, you seek answers: How did the world perish and rebirth? How did the war between the Undying Clan and humans ignite and fade... But deep whirlpools block your path at every turn, dragging you toward the abyss.
article.adventurer_note.chapter_3.body3: The wanderer's steps grow increasingly heavy.
article.adventurer_note.chapter_4.title: Character Story 3
article.adventurer_note.chapter_4.body1: You step into the blood-corroded wilderness, enter the ruined church, and gaze upon the once crimson heavens.
article.adventurer_note.chapter_4.body2: After the war between the Undying Clan and humans ended, the homeland became scorching and dim--so they migrated to a new world, peaceful and prosperous. Until a Warlock of the Undying Legion offered his wealth, family, and life in exchange for all the power within an unknown gem.
article.adventurer_note.chapter_4.body3: From that day on, the young warlock and his brother vanished from the legion, and a mindless demon overlord was born into the world.
article.adventurer_note.chapter_4.body4: Humans born of desire, gaining power, crave kingship, and lose their souls.
article.adventurer_note.chapter_4.body5: Standing beside the extinguished tomb, your sword still plunged into the soul of the fallen, you cannot help but sigh.
article.adventurer_note.chapter_5.title: Character Story 4
article.adventurer_note.chapter_5.body1: The journey to explore the world is never smooth sailing.
article.adventurer_note.chapter_5.body2: As moonlight blankets the earth, you watch in terror as new monsters emerge from the pure radiance--their ferocity growing with the moon's brightness. Fortunately, they seem particularly afraid of the sword wielded by evil spirits.
article.adventurer_note.chapter_5.body3: Most of these monsters resemble heavily corrupted Undying Clan members, while the cruelest few wear human attire. You inevitably face defeat, but just as death approaches, everything fades to black--and you wake up safe in your warm bed.
article.adventurer_note.chapter_5.body4: Finally, you defeat the most vicious Lunar Eclipse Monster.
article.adventurer_note.chapter_5.body5: The era of past prosperity has passed; we who once were will soon turn to dust.
article.adventurer_note.chapter_5.body6: So reads the note dropped by the monster.
article.adventurer_note.chapter_6.title: Character Story 5
article.adventurer_note.chapter_6.body1: Countless 'deaths' cannot break you. You descend into the Nether to seek the embers of ancient wars; you ascend to the End to defeat the world-destroying Ender Dragon.
article.adventurer_note.chapter_6.body2: I see the player… Blue and green text scrolls before your eyes--you have achieved the 'ending' countless adventurers before you dreamed of.
article.adventurer_note.chapter_6.body3: When you open your eyes again, you face the same familiar yet unfamiliar world--no changes whatsoever. Monsters still rise with the moon and fall with the sun; the cycle of death and rebirth continues endlessly.
article.adventurer_note.chapter_6.body4: So you grasp your sword and set off on the journey once more.
article.adventurer_note.chapter_7.title: Character Story 6
article.adventurer_note.chapter_7.body1: Embarking on your journey anew, you choose the vast desert as your first destination. Legend has it that a thousand years ago, this land was not a human territory, but the realm of 'Traitor Gods'.
article.adventurer_note.chapter_7.body2: You rest among the sand-buried ruins, chisel open eroded tombs, and touch the time-sealed 'past': The desert ancestors survived a cataclysmic re-creation, barely clinging to life in the desert wasteland--until a usurper bearing an 'Oracle' descended from the heavens, bringing springs and the hope of survival to the dying clan.
article.adventurer_note.chapter_7.body3: The usurper built a magnificent empire spanning the desert, with an oasis as its foundation. He chose his most devout follower as the empire's ruler--the Pharaoh--and appointed his disciples as Temple Priests. With divine power, he spread the torch of civilization to the desert's four corners--until the war between humans and the Undying Clan engulfed the world. Enraged, the gods they worshipped annihilated the ancient desert civilization.
article.adventurer_note.chapter_7.body4: At that time, wandering souls filled the land, preying on all living things. So the surviving priests sacrificed their lives to channel the most ancient leyline power beneath the desert, building a vast sacred city underground…
article.hiddenyears:13.title: Thousand Paths & Forgotten Roads
article.hiddenyears:13.body_1: The era of XXXXX has passed; we who are XXXX will soon XXXXX.
article.hiddenyears:13.body_2: In the XXXX loneliness XXXX, you are perhaps the only one with XXXX wisdom. Unfortunately, I cannot XXXX explain what exactly XXXXX--all I XXXX is that you are the 'XXX' XXXX survivor, sent beyond XXXX world by us.
article.hiddenyears:13.body_3: Our XXX has fallen; countless storms have turned XXXX to dust. You should have grown up in warmth XXXX, yet you are forced to stand before the XXXX winds. At this moment, the vast XXXX world awaits your exploration; XXXX future, XXXX will be written by you.
article.hiddenyears:14.title: The Truth of the Layered Sands
article.hiddenyears:14.body_1: My people slumbered beneath eternal ice. When they awoke, a hundred thousand days and nights had passed--our homeland lay in ruins, landscapes transformed, and countless monsters had invaded the mortal realm.
article.hiddenyears:14.body_2: As for me, exiled by my brother, I descended into the mortal world. Harnessing the world's primal power, I united the desert tribes in a blood pact, forming the Sandflow Legion to repel the monster hordes. With divine power, I sealed the treasure coveted by the world, and chose my most devout follower as the empire's ruler--the Pharaoh.
article.hiddenyears:14.body_3: The monsters were finally eradicated. We built a mighty empire, spreading civilization and prosperity across the land. But before long, a second 'God' descended from the stars.
article.hiddenyears:14.body_4: You have brought civilization to the remnants of ancient sin.
article.hiddenyears:14.body_6: My body shattered under divine punishment, and rain poured endlessly for decades--so our homeland fell once more. The former paradise became a mass grave of countless bones. My people trapped in the desert were slowly eroded by sand; the empire's soldiers turned into mindless skeletons. The vast desert became the shroud of death...
article.hiddenyears:14.body_7: The Nilot Empire fell, never to rise again.

howtoplay.hiddenyears:armor_effect.unyie: §eUnyielding§r is a mighty power that awakens in adventurers during desperate situations. When you are attacked while wearing armor with this effect, you have a chance to gain three buffs: increased resistance, strength and speed. You will also restore HP randomly, growing stronger throughout the battle.
howtoplay.hiddenyears:armor_effect.rebir: §eRebirth§r is a life-saving miracle granted by armor, made for adventurers on the brink of death. When attacked with extremely low HP, you will recover 5 HP for sure to avoid imminent defeat. Additionally, there is a chance to fully restore your HP and return to your peak state instantly.
This is the §eBlessing of the Rain God§r. While wearing armor with this effect, every time your HP decreases, you will take 25% less damage, keeping you resilient in prolonged battles.

story.intro.1: A wanderer from under the ancient stars has returned to this world,
story.intro.2: His homeland lies shattered, yet this familiar yet strange world awaits him.
story.chapter1.title: Character Story I: Sleeper in a Foreign Land
story.chapter1.1: The stars you once knew are gone, replaced by endless darkness and silence.
story.chapter1.2: You faintly recall countless civilizations born beneath the stars, all eventually fading into the eternal night.
story.chapter1.3: At last you awaken in the dark, but the world is no longer what you remember.
story.chapter1.4: You carefully search your pocket and find an old tattered note:
story.chapter1.5: The glorious ages of the past are fading away, and we who once laughed shall turn to dust.
story.chapter1.6: You will walk alone in this unfamiliar world with no companions. I cannot explain everything in detail, but brave hero, you shall fulfill the dream we chased for a thousand years of wandering.
story.chapter1.7: Survivor of the Calamity! Our homeland has fallen. Storms and hardships have turned solid stone into sand. You were meant to grow beneath the stars, yet you waste your days trapped in confinement.
story.chapter1.8: Now the whole world is yours to explore. The past and the future will be written by you.
story.chapter1.9: May you find your own truth after your long slumber in a distant land.
story.chapter2.title: Character Story II: A Fleeting Dream
story.chapter2.1: You travel across the land, gathering resources and crafting items, then fall into deep sleep when night comes.
story.chapter2.2: Until one day, corrupted creatures emerge from the ground and attack relentlessly. Caught off guard, you are struck down time and again, until the morning sun rises and burns away those foul beings...
story.chapter2.3: You realize this world is far more complicated than it seems.
